messages:
alex: Heads up — since we flipped the ALB to route v2 traffic we've seen ~2% of requests get 401 invalid_api_key. Appears intermittent and concentrated on long API keys (SSO session tokens).

maria: sorry to hear! can you paste a failing curl and the backend request header dump? also which region and org?

alex: region: us-west-2 org: acme-inc
alex: curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJI...<very long token>...kZq9" https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/usage

alex: backend raw header from app access log: Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJI...kZ
Authorization: 9qZq9

(maybe LB split it)

priya: infra note — we rolled in ALB v2 (nginx layer) at 04:12 UTC that enforces header size 8k and may fold long headers; some LBs do header folding (obs-fold) when they see long single header lines.

maria: interesting. our auth checker expects a single Authorization header string; if the header is folded into two lines nginx/httpd might assemble it with a comma which fails our parser.

alex: repro steps I ran: set AUTH=longtoken ; curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $AUTH" -v ... sometimes server sees only the first part and returns 401. i attached curl -v output (see below).

alex: curl verbose shows two `Authorization` headers being sent upstream (weird):
```
> Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJI...part1
> Authorization: part2
```

support-engineer: Can you confirm the ALB/proxy is not inserting line breaks? Also any WAF rules or header rewriting? Priya can you check ALB config and nginx proxy_set_header behavior?

priya: checking now. ALB config: request header size default 8192, and the nginx proxy had `proxy_buffer_size` small in frontends causing header splitting. I can bump buffer and set `proxy_set_header Authorization $http_authorization;` to preserve.

maria: short-term workaround: can the client send API key in `X-API-Key` header or as `Authorization: Bearer` but base64-encoded single chunk? longer-term fix is to ensure upstream doesn't fold headers. Also we'll add tolerant parsing to join multiple Authorization headers before parsing.

alex: confirmed after bumping proxy buffers and setting explicit proxy_set_header the server sees a single header and 401s stop for test users. Thanks!

priya: rolling a config change to prod in next 10m: nginx proxy_buffer_size -> 32k & proxy_busy_buffers_size increased. will monitor.

maria: created ticket INF-1832 to harden LB and update docs: recommend using Authorization header < 8k or use X-Api-Key. marking as resolved for now but will keep monitoring. :white_check_mark:

infra-bot: deploy noted: config/ingress/nginx updated by priya at 6123456805

alex: great — thanks all :tada:
